fusions.name: Grappling Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a grapnel into the first enemy it meets that deals 13 damage, and you rush up to 7 tiles to it.

fusions.name: Gaffed Aboard
fusions.desc: Strikes only a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with rank: it deals 22 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Haul Them Alongside
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barb in the Gunwale
fusions.desc: Against a target below half health, your damage rises by 12%.
